Volcanoes of the Pacific Rim

The Ring of Fire hosts roughly three quarters of the world's active volcanoes. Subduction of oceanic plates feeds magma chambers beneath island arcs.

Notable eruptions

  • Krakatoa, 1883
  • Mount Pinatubo, 1991
  • Mount St. Helens, 1980

Monitoring networks track seismicity, gas emissions and ground deformation to forecast eruptions.
